Stackpole]]. It was published by [[Bantam Spectra]] in [[October]] [[1996]]. Narration for the [[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap (unabridged audiobook)|audio]] version was performed by [[Henry Thomas]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] has just captured the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] from the hands of imperial leader [[Ysanne Isard]]. But instead of a glorious victory the Rebels discover a horrible truth; The planet's non-Human population has been infected with a vicious disease called the [[Krytos virus]]. It can be cured by [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]], but the demand is too much for the planet to handle. [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] is assigned to attack [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] and his space station that contained a healthy amount of bacta that had been stolen from a deep space convoy. The assignment is difficult, maybe impossible, but in the words of [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]]: "Impossible is what the Rogues do best."
